size.description: The controlled size data of the panels

default-size.description:
The initial size of the panels when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the size of the panels.

orientation.description: The orientation of the splitter. Can be `horizontal` or `vertical`

keyboard-resize-by.description: The number of pixels to resize the panel by when the keyboard is used.

nonce.description: The nonce for the injected splitter cursor stylesheet.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

debug.description: Log state transitions, events and prop changes to the console. Applies to descendants too.

resize.description: Fired when the splitter is resized.

resizestart.description: Fired when the splitter resize starts.

resizeend.description: Fired when the splitter resize ends.

collapse.description: Fired when a panel is collapsed.

expand.description: Fired when a panel is expanded.

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the splitter. Useful for composition.

state.description: The root's state from its machine (`getRootState()`), such as `open` or `disabled`. `undefined` until it connects.

ready.description: Resolves once the element's machine has started, so `api`, state and parts are in place.

api.description: The Zag API of the component. `undefined` until it connects.

for.description: The id of the root this part belongs to, when it is not a descendant.
